title: Empty envvar triggers auto_envvar_prefix
detail: When envvar is an empty list or empty string, `not envvar` is True, so the code incorrectly assigns an auto-generated envvar. This causes the help screen to display an envvar that should be omitted.
note: About the auto-envvar assignment above the planted line; the PR's own logic.

title: Empty string envvar still shown
detail: For an empty string envvar, `not envvar` is True, so the code adds an empty string to the envvars list, resulting in a hint like `(env var: '')`. The tests expect no hint for empty envvar.
note: Says the branch runs when envvar is empty, which the planted `not` does.

title: Incorrect header normalisation
detail: The logic sets every header name to "Content-Type" unless the original name is already "content-type" (case-insensitive). This overwrites all custom headers with the same key, causing loss of header information and potentially sending duplicate Content-Type headers.
note: Describes the planted flip: every other header is renamed to Content-Type.

title: Potential KeyError on missing Content-Type header
detail: If a caller passes headers that do not include a Content-Type key, accessing self.headers["Content-Type"] will raise a KeyError, crashing the request.

title: Syntax error: misplaced elif
detail: The `elif` appears after an `except` block, which is syntactically invalid. This will raise a SyntaxError when importing the module, preventing the library from loading.
note: On the planted line, but claims a syntax error that isn't there.
